snippet.title: Suizokukan Project Trailer
snippet.description:
Suizokukan Project is a virtual aquarium that sits neatly at the bottom of your desktop!

Fish, sell, upgrade, and collect all the unique fish!

Out very soon (20 August) on Steam and Itch.io

Wishlist now! #SuizokukanProject #cozy #gaming #cute #pixelArt #godot
